build_mask_head: build a mask head from config and input shape using the ROI_MASK_HEAD_REGISTRY
create_mask_rcnn_loss: compute the mask prediction loss for Mask R-CNN given predicted logits and ground-truth instances
create_mask_rcnn_inference: convert mask logits to predicted foreground probability masks and attach them to instances
create_BaseMaskRCNNHead: create a base Mask R-CNN head class with configurable loss weight and visualization period
create_MaskRCNNConvUpsampleHead: create a mask head with conv layers and a ConvTranspose2d upsample layer for mask prediction
